perks.name: Stable Resonance
perks.description: Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.
perks.exact:
On Elite+ Kill:
7% Increased Weapon Damage and Resist x2 (25% DR) for 12 seconds.

perks.name: Resonance Redirection
perks.description: While you have Stable Resonance, continued weapon damage occasionally generates a resonance burst that damages and exhausts targets.
perks.exact:
While Stable Resonance is active:
Dealing 600? Weapon Damage within ? seconds of each triggers an Exhausting Blast, centered on the enemy.
Incurs an 2? second cooldown between Exhausting Blasts.

Exhausting Blast deals ? Damage and inflicts Exhaust over 8 meters, reducing Combatant Damage Output by 25%.

archetype.name: Specialist
archetype.description:
Armor configured for Guardians who seek a flexible approach to combat.

Primary Stat: Class
Secondary Stat: Weapons

item.name: +Grenade / -Health
item.description: Increases this armor's Tuned stat at the cost of a small amount of the Health stat.

archetype.description:

Secondary Stat: Melee

item.description: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Heavy ammo meter.

item.name: Harmonic Siphon
item.description: Rapid Arc weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
item.exact:
Upon scoring 2 Mod-Element Matching Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each:

Spawns an Orb of Power.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon spawning an Orbs of Power before additional kills count.

Orb of Power:
2.5% | 3.75% | 4.4% Super Energy.
